title.en: Your Role at an Imaginary Stargazing Night
title.zh: 想象观星夜：你会带来什么？

description.en: Six choices about a fictional sky gathering: finding patterns, giving them stories and making an evening easy to join. No astronomy knowledge required.
description.zh: 围绕一场虚构星空聚会做六次选择：找图案、讲故事、让夜晚容易参与。不需要天文学知识。

introduction.en: The sky in this quiz is a made-up star chart. You are helping create a recreational evening around it, so you can choose practical comfort, visual patterns or a shared story without needing to identify a real constellation.
introduction.zh: 测试里的天空是一张虚构星图。你正围绕它组织休闲夜晚，可以选实际舒适、视觉图案或共同故事，不需要辨认真实星座。

focus.en: Making a shared sky-chart evening memorable through its pattern, its narrative or its practical welcome.
focus.zh: 通过图案、叙事或实际欢迎方式，让共同看星图的夜晚留下记忆。

prompt.en: The gathering begins with an unfamiliar star chart. You…
prompt.zh: 聚会从一张陌生星图开始，你会……

label.en: Connect a few dots into an easy-to-find shape.
label.zh: 把几颗点连成容易找的形状。

label.en: Invent a short tale for one cluster.
label.zh: 给一簇星点编个短故事。

label.en: Make sure everyone has a comfortable place to view it.
label.zh: 让每个人都有舒服看图的位置。

prompt.en: A new person arrives halfway through. You offer…
prompt.zh: 中途来了一个新人，你提供……

label.en: A place to settle and a simple outline of the evening.
label.zh: 安顿的位置与今晚安排的简单说明。

label.en: The three dots that orient the whole picture.
label.zh: 能定位整张图的三个点。

label.en: The one-sentence version of the story so far.
label.zh: 至今故事的一句话版本。

prompt.en: Two clusters look similar. You would enjoy…
prompt.zh: 两簇星点看起来相像，你会喜欢……

label.en: Giving them different characters in a shared tale.
label.zh: 在故事里给它们不同角色。

label.en: Comparing the small difference between their shapes.
Checking whether the group wants a pause before continuing.
label.zh: 问大家继续前是否想休息。

prompt.en: There is room for one extra activity. You choose…
prompt.zh: 还有空间加一个小活动，你选……

label.en: Let each person trace one invented constellation.
label.zh: 让每人描一个自创星座图案。

label.en: A brief round where everyone can add a story sentence.
label.zh: 一小轮人人可添一句的故事。

label.en: A relaxed break with an easy return to the chart.
label.zh: 一段放松休息，也方便回来接着看。

prompt.en: The printed chart is too crowded for the whole group. You…
prompt.zh: 印出的星图太密，大家看得费力，你会……

label.en: Split the viewing into comfortable smaller turns.
Highlight just one cluster for the next few minutes.
label.zh: 接下来几分钟只突出一簇。

label.en: Tell one small story without requiring every dot to be found.
label.zh: 讲个不必找齐每颗星的小故事。

prompt.en: What souvenir would you make for this imaginary night?
prompt.zh: 你会为这个想象夜晚做什么纪念？

label.en: A little story with room for someone else’s ending.
label.zh: 一个给别人留结尾空间的小故事。

label.en: A simple chart of the shapes the group invented.
label.zh: 一张标着大家自创形状的简图。

label.en: A note about how to make the next gathering welcoming.
label.zh: 一笔关于下次如何让聚会舒适的记录。

summary.en: Your imaginary sky night gains a few clear shapes. You make the chart approachable by connecting just enough dots to offer a starting point. This is a story role, not a test of spatial intelligence or real astronomical knowledge.
summary.zh: 你的想象星空夜有了几处清楚形状。你连上恰好的几个点，为陌生星图提供起点。这是故事角色，不测试空间智力或真实天文知识。

example.en: When introducing a complex game map, you might point out three main landmarks before explaining every symbol scattered between them.
example.zh: 介绍复杂游戏地图时，你可能先指出三个主要地标，再慢慢解释其间散落的符号。

strength.en: A simple visible pattern can lower the first step into a busy picture and give a group something specific to notice together.
strength.zh: 简单可见图案能降低进入复杂画面的第一步，也给群体一个可共同留意的具体对象。

tradeoff.en: A useful starting pattern may leave other details out. It works best as an invitation to explore rather than the only valid way to read the chart.
tradeoff.zh: 有用起始图案难免省略细节。把它当探索邀请，而非唯一合法读法，会更合适。

experiment.en: Take one crowded recreational image and mark a simple starting route. Ask another person what different path they would like to follow.
experiment.zh: 选一张内容多的休闲图片，标一条简单起始路线，再问别人愿意走哪条不同路径。

summary.en: Your made-up constellations become characters and connections in a shared tale. The gathering can enjoy the sky without memorizing its whole chart. The ending reflects the narrative choices you made here, rather than declaring you a born storyteller.
summary.zh: 你的虚构星座变成共同故事里的角色与联系。聚会不必背完整张星图，也能享受天空。结局对应本次叙事选择，不宣称你天生就是讲故事的人。

example.en: At a drawing afternoon, you might connect everyone’s separate sketches with a playful one-sentence premise that each person is free to change.
example.zh: 绘画下午，你可能用一句有趣开头连接各人的独立草图，也允许每个人改写它。

strength.en: A shared narrative can make unfamiliar details memorable and offer a way to participate that does not depend on technical knowledge.
strength.zh: 共同叙事能让陌生细节留下记忆，也提供一种不依赖专业知识的参与方式。

tradeoff.en: One lively story can crowd out other readings if it becomes fixed too quickly. Leaving an unfinished line can help other people add their own view.
tradeoff.zh: 活泼故事若太快固定，也可能挤掉其他读法。留一句未完，能让别人添自己的视角。

experiment.en: Make a tiny story from three unrelated objects. Invite someone to replace one sentence, and see what new connection appears.
experiment.zh: 用三个不相关物体编个微型故事。邀请别人替换一句，看看会出现什么新联系。

summary.en: Your sky gathering is held together by a place to settle, a pause and a clear way back in. The chart matters, but so does being able to enjoy it. This portrait values practical welcome without assigning you responsibility for every guest.
summary.zh: 你的星空聚会靠安顿位置、适当停顿和清楚返回方式串起来。星图重要，能自在欣赏也重要。画像珍惜实际欢迎，不让你对每位来客负责到底。

example.en: For a casual photo-sharing evening, you might check seating and make a break possible before adding more slides to an already full plan.
example.zh: 办一场轻松照片分享夜，你可能先看看座位、留休息机会，再决定是否继续加幻灯片。

strength.en: Practical comfort can make an unfamiliar activity easier to enter, especially when people want different amounts of time or conversation.
strength.zh: 实际舒适让陌生活动更易加入，尤其当大家需要的停留与交流程度不同。

tradeoff.en: Preparing every detail can leave you little room to enjoy the evening yourself. A simple arrangement shared with others may be enough.
tradeoff.zh: 照顾每个细节可能让你无暇享受夜晚。与大家共同做个简单安排，也许已足够。

experiment.en: For one small gathering, choose the two practical details that matter most and share one preparation task with someone who wants to help.
experiment.zh: 为一次小聚会选最重要的两项实际细节，再把一件准备工作交给愿意帮忙的人一起做。
